summary.description: 2-4 short bullets: what changed and why. Don't list what stayed the same, files you didn't touch, or test results (reported separately).

addressed.description: One short line per reviewer finding you acted on. Not for comments you answered in a thread. Empty on a first implementation.

blocked_reason.description: Why the approved design cannot be implemented as written. Empty unless blocked.

comment_id.description: comment_id of an inline comment shown in the conversation.

body.description: One sentence: what you did, or why you made no change. No thanks, no restating the request.

thread_replies.description: At most one reply per human thread you were given. Empty if there are none.

commit_title.description: Imperative commit title for this round's change, at most 72 characters, e.g. 'Load empty !!null nodes as Null' or 'Name the null tag constant'. No issue number.

declined.description: Maintainer requests you did NOT implement because they need a design change, one short line each. Usually empty.
